independent_source_box_checks.excluded: result_type locations have region null and are page-only; not included in exact-position denominator.
independent_source_box_checks.limitation: This validates source alignment of the 30 annotation rectangles, not parser localization success, pixel-perfect polygon boundaries, or the unboxed remainder of the corpus.

privacy: Medical transcriptions and source paths remain in ignored local .runtime; published artifact contains only counts, hashes and methodology.
method: Two direct-source annotation passes; 34 row disagreements resolved against source pages; 12 name disagreements and 30 existing boxes separately reviewed by a third source-only reader. Parser output is never annotation truth.
limits: Development regression sample set only; no holdout or generalization claim
Source page fallback is not precise field localization
Unannotated relevant reports must not be described as source-unreadable merely because annotation is incomplete
Second reader saw pre-existing source classifications and row counts, but neither primary field transcriptions nor parser predictions. All counts are development regression; no holdout claim.
